verbatim_quote.original: تو نباید سولو کار کنی؛ باید همه پرسوناهای برین را کانسالت کنی
verbatim_quote.english_translation: You must not work solo; you must consult all of the Brain personas.

extracted_decision.summary: In autopilot, the Hands must consult all Brain personas (QA, Planner, Designer, Strategist, Programmer) instead of working solo.
extracted_decision.rationale: Solo autopilot work misses cross-disciplinary verdicts; the Manager rebuked it and ordered full persona consultation.
alternatives: Continue solo autopilot and report at the end
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: More Brain turns per task, but verdicts catch debt early.
